name: Password Sign-In TOTP Required
summary: A user enters through Welcome, chooses email authentication, submits valid password credentials for an account whose only available MFA method is TOTP, receives the generic MFA-required server outcome, and the client routes directly to the existing TOTP Sign In flow.
finalOutcome: The password proof is accepted, no authenticated application session is issued yet, and TOTP-only client response routing places the user on the canonical TOTP continuation surface; the existing TOTP Sign In category owns the remaining ceremony.

sourceReferences.note: The server populates availableMfaProviders for the generic MFA-required outcome without completing application sign-in.
Angular Web routes a TOTP-only availableMfaProviders response directly to AuthRoutes.continueTotp.
React Native recognizes TOTP-only MFA-required responses before session persistence and returns the mfa-totp outcome.
React Native routes the mfa-totp password outcome to /auth/continue/totp.
Canonical TOTP continuation surface is the direct destination when TOTP is the only available MFA method.
A one-element TOTP provider set routes directly to auth.continue.totp; users with both TOTP and Passkey route to auth.select.mfa-type instead.
